intersections.note: Ammen (50 ft) runs east from Spring Grove (100 ft). Spring Grove's centre taken midway between its two faces (they are about 610 px apart here, the water pipe runs at x 417). Spring Grove also changes direction slightly here: north of Ammen it leans about 3 deg more on the page
Center (40 ft) comes from the top edge and ends at Ammen

Mitchell (60 ft) runs east from Spring Grove. Spring Grove centre midway between its faces (x 83 and 711). The north leg of Mitchell is not drawn on this sheet, but its two water pipes enter Spring Grove obliquely from the NW and would meet the Spring Grove centre at about x 397, y 6490 (about 290 px, 49 ft, north of this pick), matching the jog seen on 649

Donnell St. (50 ft) leaves Spring Grove to the SE at about 39 deg; its NE face meets Mitchell's south face at the Spring Grove face (x 714, y 6935), so its centreline reaches the Spring Grove centre almost at the Mitchell point. Its water pipe is drawn joining Spring Grove further south (y about 7100); the point follows the faces

ends.note: east end of Ammen at the west line of the B. & O. railroad

notes: Single panel, drawn rotated about 45 deg (the north arrow points to the upper left): Spring Grove Av. (100 ft) runs down the left side of the page, Mitchell Av. (60 ft) runs from it to the right edge near the bottom, Donnell St. (50 ft) leaves it SE at the bottom left. Ammen Av. (50 ft) runs from Spring Grove to the B. & O. railroad, with Center Av. (40 ft) coming in from the top edge. East of the B. & O. are the Lewis Lipp Co. works and open ground; no other streets. Spring Grove's NW face is the long line near the left edge (x 245 at the top, 115 at y 2000, 83 at y 6400); its SE face is the lot fronts (x 850 at the top, 729 at Ammen, 711 at Mitchell); centres are taken midway, which agrees with the water pipe at Ammen. Mitchell and Donnell meet Spring Grove almost at the same point (see 649, where the two picks are about 48 px apart). Railroads and spur tracks ignored.
